# branding

Intro paragraph.

## Selection contract

<!-- Read by packages/research-enrich to judge whether a document belongs in this topic. English on purpose. -->

- **Purpose:** Gather how brands are created and managed — strategy, equity, identity, naming, psychology, culture, research, and measurement — including a sports and wearable brand benchmark.
- **Core:** Brand strategy, equity, and positioning; identity, naming, color, marks, and distinctive assets; consumer memory, fluency, and culture; research and measurement methods; and the verbal and visual systems of the audited sports and wearable brands.
- **Adjacent (keep):** Sensory marketing, narrative persuasion, and semiotics, because the corpus treats them as evidence about perception and meaning, not as general psychology. Design-discovery methods sit in the research-methods slice of the same collection.
- **Collected on purpose:** The 23 research PDFs and their Firecrawl Markdown, kept as provenance plus text (including Keller and Aaker extracts). The 2026-09-06 audit of homepages, about pages, product pages, and agency cases for WHOOP, Oura, Nike, Catapult, and similar brands, plus screenshots.
- **Out of scope:** Coaching drills and specification sheets that never discuss a name, a mark, a color system, or a brand claim. Storefronts that only sell templates or generated artwork and contain no equity or perception study. Registry filing steps that never discuss strategy. Login walls and ad previews that are not the research text.
